get.description: Check if a phone number or email supports FaceTime

schema.description: Phone number (E.164) or email to check.

parameters.description: Phone number (E.164) or email to check.
parameters.name: to

200.description: Check if a phone number or email supports FaceTime

post.description: Place an outbound FaceTime Audio call

to.description: Recipient's phone number (E.164) or FaceTime email.

from.description: Your leased FaceTime Audio number. If omitted, a random FaceTime Audio number of yours is used.

caller_id.description: Optional caller ID to present in the call. Appears as 'Maybe: caller_id'.

200.description: Place an outbound FaceTime Audio call

ft_audio_line.description: The FaceTime Audio number this call is on.

caller_id.description: Caller ID presented on this call.

cause.description: Why the call ended. dialer_hungup if you POST /hangup; recipient_hungup if the remote party left then orchard sent ended. Otherwise orchard's cause.

join.description: URL to join this call as the Contiguity FaceTime Audio line.

webrtc.description: WebRTC credentials for joining the call's audio room.

participants.description: Handles orchard has listed on this call. Live this is the current roster; after end it is everyone who appeared.

duration.description: Call duration in seconds. Null while the call is active.
